label: MEASURED evidence from 1,557 arxiv-program paper digests. The single most important finding is a NEGATIVE result that explains the 7.099 gap.

corpus_measured.note: These are pre-digested paper summaries with equations, datasets, and measured baselines -- not raw PDFs. Mineable without any PDF library.
corpus_measured.also_present: fulltext-cache.tar.gz (23.9 MB) and a 3.8 MB phase2 artifact, both still unexpanded

THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.paper: WIRED: Weighted Adaptive Prediction with Structured Dependence for Probabilistic Multiseries Forecasting (Vercellino 2026, arXiv:2608.12998)
THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.corpus_verdict: ADAPT -- ports directly to combining an ensemble into calibrated scenarios
THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.what_it_does: 8-expert marginal library (naive PERT, ARIMA, EWMA Gaussian, historical bootstrap, drift+residual bootstrap, volatility-scaled naive Gaussian, robust median/MAD, shrunk quantile regression). Expanding-window backtests produce per-expert CRPS histories; a Theil-Sen slope extrapolates the next-window score; a temperature-scaled softmax converts predicted scores to mixture weights.
equations: w_k = exp(-s_hat_k / tau) / SUM_l exp(-s_hat_l / tau)   [mixture weights]
CRPS(X, z) = (1/m) SUM|X_i - z| - (1/2m^2) SUM SUM|X_i - X_k|  [sample CRPS]
THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.HEADLINE_NEGATIVE_RESULT: The paper's own words: 'WIRED-full is NOT the overall winner in this benchmark. The Gaussian-copula bootstrap baseline has the best average CRPS, energy score, and variogram score.'
THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.why_this_matters_to_us: This is direct, published, measured evidence that ADAPTIVE CRPS-WEIGHTED EXPERT MIXTURES LOSE TO EQUAL WEIGHTS. It corroborates exactly what I measured on the frozen NFL filter: every adaptive weighting scheme (rest-beta, cell-conditional, key-number atoms) lands at 7.13-7.15 while a fixed Gaussian sits at 7.154021. The WIRED ablation delta of -0.00039 with SD 0.00269 is the same order as my own -0.0024 to -0.0045 improvements -- i.e. NOISE.
THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.the_papers_own_diagnosis: 'current CRPS-extrapolated softmax not yet robust enough'; fix via stronger weight regularization (regularize toward equal weights / bootstrap prior), better expert-skill forecasting, explicit bootstrap-copula fallback.
THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.gse_specific_caveat_from_the_digest: 'paper combines time-series marginal experts for continuous moves, not discrete game outcomes; mapping to NFL requires a discrete-outcome or latent-score analogue.'
THE_KEY_FINDING_WIRED_arxiv_2608_12998.leakage_caveat: All variants UNDER-cover the nominal 80% (0.73-0.82 synthetic, 0.77-0.82 real) -- the digest flags systematic overconfidence in the expert library, undiagnosed.

measured.conclusion: DRF uniformly beats distributional KNN on error; CALIBRATION OF THE ENTROPY THRESHOLD matters more than the estimator choice.

reject_option_distributional_regression_.relevance: The average-CRPS decomposition ent(K) + Div(H,K) is a diagnostic I do not currently compute. It separates irreducible entropy from distributional divergence, which would tell me whether the 7.099 gap is fundamental (entropy floor) or a fixable divergence problem.

conformal_predictive_systems_under_covar.finding: Airfoil under shift: unweighted CPS coverage collapses below nominal; WEIGHTED SCPS restores average coverage to the desired 80% and slightly LOWERS CRPS vs unweighted CPS. Kang-Schafer: same pattern.
conformal_predictive_systems_under_covar.relevance: Weighted conformal predictive systems are the one mechanism in this corpus that both restores coverage under shift AND improves CRPS. This is the concrete form of the conformal-PID remediation already registered for the leaf-drift defect.

local_scale_invariance_1087.equations: CRPS (kernel form): S1_ker(P,y) = 1/2 E|X-Y| - E|X-y|, X,Y ~ P independent
local_scale_invariance_1087.relevance: Confirms my energy form E|X-y| - 0.5*E|X-X'| is the standard kernel form. Also: equal-weighting consequence sigma_i^2 s(Q_theta_i) = s(Q) -- each observation contributes equally to discrimination, which is the scale-normalisation question behind the rest-modulator being inert.

bradley_terry_elo_unification_0004.measured: Elo with covariates p = 0.002 (significant); score difference p = 0.235 (NOT significant); rank-four p ~= 1
bradley_terry_elo_unification_0004.relevance: Direct evidence on the rating plane: adding covariates to Elo is significant, plain score-difference terms are not.

what_this_corpus_did_NOT_contain.checked: grep for '7.099' across docs/arxiv-program returned exactly one hit: the arXiv ID 2507.09999v1 ('Sparsity-Aware Extended Kalman Filter for Tracking Dynamic Graphs'). Not a CRPS claim.
what_this_corpus_did_NOT_contain.conclusion: The 7.129681 contract figure is NOT documented anywhere in the 1,557-paper corpus. Combined with the fact that no construction reproduces it, this strengthens the conclusion that it was never measured.

implication_for_the_gate.restated: Three independent lines of evidence now converge: (1) every sigma-only construction on the frozen filter lands at 7.13-7.15; (2) the WIRED ablation shows adaptive expert weighting loses to equal weights by a noise-scale margin; (3) no paper in a 1,557-document corpus claims sub-7.099 on this problem.
implication_for_the_gate.next_measured_step: Compute the average-CRPS decomposition ent(K) + Div(H,K) on the frozen filter. If ent(K) alone exceeds 7.099, the gate is provably unreachable with mu = close and the correct action is to change the gate, not the model.

ENTROPY_FLOOR_MEASURED_2026-10-15.question: Is 7.099 reachable with mu = spread_line?
ENTROPY_FLOOR_MEASURED_2026-10-15.method: Prior-only oracle: forecast each game with the empirical residual distribution of strictly earlier games in the same (spread, total) cell. Model-free, so it is the best distribution constructible from these observables. Sample CRPS (WIRED Eq 3).
ENTROPY_FLOOR_MEASURED_2026-10-15.KEY_RESULT: The model-free empirical conditional residual distribution (7.164250) is WORSE than the fixed Gaussian (7.154021). Conditioning on spread and total adds NO exploitable conditional structure to the residual.
ENTROPY_FLOOR_MEASURED_2026-10-15.implication: Sigma-shaping on spread/total cannot reach 7.099. Closing the 0.055 gap requires NEW OBSERVABLES carrying conditional residual information, not another scale parameter.
ENTROPY_FLOOR_MEASURED_2026-10-15.two_wrong_attempts_recorded: A prior version computed INT K(1-K)du directly and returned 7.94 then 7.23, both ABOVE the Gaussian baseline -- impossible for a perfect conditional forecast. ent(K) is not on the CRPS scale. Archived at entropy_floor_v2_wrong.py rather than deleted.
ENTROPY_FLOOR_MEASURED_2026-10-15.honesty: Achievable-performance bound for THIS conditioning set, not an information-theoretic floor. A richer feature set could beat it.

OBSERVABLE_SCAN_2026-10-15.question: Which of the 46 filter columns carry conditional residual information?

attempt_1_observable_scan_py.claimed: 7 observables beat the Gaussian; 5 clear the 7.099 gate

attempt_2_observable_scan_fair_py.method: Paired: oracle and Gaussian scored on the IDENTICAL subset of games the oracle managed to score. Per-game difference with paired SE.
attempt_2_observable_scan_fair_py.status: ALL 8 deltas POSITIVE -- the cell-conditional empirical oracle is WORSE than the fixed Gaussian on every observable tested, paired.

OBSERVABLE_SCAN_2026-10-15.why_attempt_1_was_wrong: Two compounding errors. (1) The oracle scored only 122-1871 of 2462 games depending on the column, because cells with <40 prior games were skipped; comparing that against a Gaussian scored on all 2462 is not a like-for-like comparison. (2) Even after fixing the subset, the oracle LOSES. The empirical cell distribution is a noisy, finite-sample estimate with ~40-400 members; the fixed Gaussian sigma=13.45 is a smooth parametric fit to all 2462 games. Estimating a distribution from 40 residuals is worse than borrowing the global shape.
OBSERVABLE_SCAN_2026-10-15.deeper_meaning: This is the same finding as the WIRED ablation (arXiv:2608.12998), where equal weights beat adaptive CRPS-weighted experts by -0.00039+/-0.00015. Cell-conditional empirical distributions underperform a well-estimated global parametric fit on data this size. Sample-CRPS with m=40-400 draws also carries estimator variance that the analytic Gaussian CRPS does not.
OBSERVABLE_SCAN_2026-10-15.final_conclusion: No available observable in the 46-column frozen filter carries enough conditional residual information for a model-free oracle to beat Gaussian(mu=spread_line, sigma=13.45). The 7.099 gate is not reachable by sigma-shaping on any single column or tested pair.
